name: Hell Guide
source:
There is an old Western-style house deep in the mountains.... Some beautiful girls live there.... One night, Jouji, a hell guide, visits the house. His mission is to guide spirits of deceased people to another world. However, he also has evil desires.... Ai, who suffers from an obstinate disease, Mai, Ai's younger sister, and Mio, their mother. He disguises himself as a butler and starts living there. Amid a whirl of desire and madness, what will happen to them...?

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
深山里有一栋古老的西式洋馆…数名美丽女性居住其中…一天夜里，地狱向导丈二来到宅邸。他的职责是把死者灵魂引向另一个世界，心中却也怀有邪恶欲望…身患顽疾的爱、爱的妹妹舞，以及二人的母亲美绪。丈二伪装成管家，开始住进宅邸。在欲望与疯狂形成的漩涡里，她们将遭遇什么…？
